label: Agent
definition: Makes or performs music.

label: Album
definition: A release whose Apple title has no ' - Single' or ' - EP' suffix. Apple lists BTS's mini albums this way.

label: Album series
definition: Releases that form one creative series, such as Love Yourself.

label: Audio analysis
definition: One measurement of audio features, from one track or preview. Features describe this audio, not the song across all its versions.

label: Chart
definition: A Billboard chart.

label: Creative work
definition: Music and its releases.

label: EP
definition: A release whose Apple title ends in ' - EP'.

label: Estimated analysis
definition: Tempo and energy estimated with librosa from a 30-second preview of a song.

label: Group
definition: A music group.

label: Interlude
definition: A song its release titles as an interlude.

label: Intro
definition: A song its release titles as an intro. Many are full-length songs.

label: Member
definition: A member of BTS.

label: Outro
definition: A song its release titles as an outro. Many are full-length songs.

label: Person
definition: Someone credited as writer, lyricist, composer or producer.

label: Recording
definition: One version of a song: original, live, remix, demo, Japanese and so on.

label: Release
definition: An album, EP or single.

label: Single
definition: A release whose Apple title ends in ' - Single'.

label: Skit
definition: A spoken track its release titles as a skit.

label: Song
definition: A composition, across all its versions.

label: Track
definition: A song as listed on Spotify or Deezer.

label: Verified analysis
definition: Spotify's audio features for one track, via ReccoBeats.

label: Video
definition: A video of one song on BTS's YouTube channel.
